value.rationale: The physically natural question is how much of the tagged position law remains out of its nonequilibrium stationary distribution as depth n increases. The source provides local accumulation time but no quantitative global probability-metric profile. The exact F(theta) distinguishes substantial persistent precritical deviation from postcritical exponential convergence, while the critical coefficient quantifies finite-depth corrections at the wavefront. The single-crossing theorem provides an exact central-interval observational interpretation. These are nontrivial functional (TV) and critical-index statements rather than routine single-parameter substitution, although extension beyond this solvable model is not shown.
